WhyAtsIA.title: Why choose an AI ATS over a classic ATS?
WhyAtsIA.intro: Traditional ATS only search for keywords in CVs, ruling out qualified talent for technical reasons. Seeklon's semantic AI
WhyAtsIA.bodyMiddle: not words. Using natural language processing, our algorithm understands the context of experience, detects soft skills and identifies transferable skills. Result:
WhyAtsIA.savingsDesc: per hire: automation of sourcing (4h), CV screening (5h) and interview scheduling (3h).
WhyAtsIA.costDesc: By handling screening in-house with AI, you save on headhunter fees (15-20% of gross salary) while keeping quality.
WhyAtsIA.qualityDesc: Our AI analyzes soft skills and culture fit to reduce early turnover by 40%.
WhyAtsIA.trustDesc: Seeklon centralizes applications from LinkedIn, Indeed, Monster and generates personalized interview guides. Data hosted in France, GDPR compliance guaranteed.

Product.intro: From job posting to final interview, Seeklon automates your most time-consuming tasks.
Product.ctaNote: No credit card required • Set up in 2 min
Product.aiProfilesDesc: Forget keyword search that eliminates good profiles. Our AI analyzes semantics, career path, and potential. It reads the CV like a human expert would, but in a fraction of a second.
Product.candidateCardQuote: Relevant profile. Validated technical skills. Management experience aligned with the need.
Product.diffuseDesc: Connect Seeklon to LinkedIn, Indeed, Monster and your social networks. Publish your job from our interface and let the magic happen. All applications funnel into one pipeline.
Product.interviewDesc: AI doesn't stop at sorting. For each selected candidate, Seeklon generates a custom interview guide with questions to ask and points to delve into, based on CV and job offer analysis.
Product.interviewSuggestedQuestion: Can you detail your experience on project X mentioned in your CV?

Privacy.useIntro: The information we collect allows us to:
Privacy.useLi1: Provide, operate and maintain our website
Privacy.useLi2: Improve, personalize and develop our website
Privacy.useLi3: Understand and analyze how you use our website
Privacy.useLi4: Communicate with you, including for customer service
Privacy.securityContent: We take the security of your data very seriously. We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against accidental or unlawful destruction, loss, alteration, disclosure or unauthorized access.

About.title: Hiring works better when everyone sees the same thing.
About.intro: Seeklon builds a shared workspace for SMBs, HR teams and managers who want to decide with clear criteria.
About.metaDescription: Learn why Seeklon is building recruitment software for SMBs around clarity, control and teamwork.
About.storyTitle: One shared workbench, from role to interview.
About.storyBody: A job post, a CV, an interview note: context quickly scatters across tools. Seeklon brings those elements together so everyone involved understands the role, finds useful information and documents the decision.
About.productAlt: Candidate profile viewed in the Seeklon recruitment workspace
About.clarityText: Information related to the role and candidate stays readable and in the right place.
About.controlText: The tool prepares and organises. The recruitment team always makes the decision.
About.teamText: Recruiters and managers share the same framework before, during and after the interview.

Rgpd.title: GDPR & Cookie policy
Rgpd.rightsContent: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the following rights regarding your personal data:
Rgpd.rightsLi1: Right of access: You have the right to request copies of your personal data.
Rgpd.rightsLi2: Right to rectification: You have the right to ask us to correct any information you believe is inaccurate.
Rgpd.rightsLi3: Right to erasure: You have the right to ask us to erase your personal data, under certain conditions.
Rgpd.cookiesContent: Our site uses cookies to improve your browsing experience. These cookies are essential for the site to function and help us understand how you use it. You can configure your browser to refuse cookies at any time.
Rgpd.dpoContent: For any questions regarding the protection of your data or to exercise your rights, you can contact our Data Protection Officer at: contact@seeklon.com
